description: Searches the UNIALL index of tokenized real-world assets by free-text query (name, ticker, issuer) and filters for category, chain, issuer, AUM, transfer standard and verification. Results include verified and unverified assets; verified assets rank first. Set verified_only=true to return verified assets only. Category keys: equities, real_estate, etfs_funds, commodities_precious_metals, private_credit, treasuries (includes money market funds), money_market, commodities_other, structured_products, collectibles, corporate_bonds.

category.description: Asset category key or list of keys. One of: equities, real_estate, etfs_funds, commodities_precious_metals, private_credit, treasuries, money_market, commodities_other, structured_products, collectibles, corporate_bonds.

chain.description: Blockchain name, e.g. ethereum, base, polygon, solana

issuer.description: Issuer name or alias, case-insensitive, e.g. BlackRock, Ondo

min_aum_usd.description: Minimum assets under management in USD

query.description: Free-text search over asset name, symbol, underlying name/ticker, and issuer name (e.g. BUIDL, BlackRock).

transfer_standard.description: On-chain transfer restriction standard filter (e.g. securitize-ds, erc1404).

verified_only.description: When true, only verified assets. Default false — includes indexed (unverified) assets; verified still rank first.

name: find_assets

answer.description: Short natural-language summary of the result.

assets.description: Matched assets when applicable (find_assets). Empty or omitted for stats/summary tools.

disclaimer.description: Fixed data-only disclaimer; not investment advice.

facts.description: Sourced scalar facts. Each item has field, value, source_url, source_type, as_of.

title: Find tokenized assets
